svg.text: src/features/projects/components/ · from the first render to creating a project (or cancelling)
A · FIRST RENDER — the dialog is mounted but closed
const router = useRouter() → used after creating (step 9)
→ just a function to call later: NO network call now
const handleSubmit = async (e) => { ... } → defined, not called yet
open is false → Radix renders NO dialog content (nothing visible)
Click New, or press Ctrl J
Ctrl J: the useEffect keydown listener → setNewProjectDialogOpen(true)
Radix renders it in a Portal (on top of the page) with a dark overlay
Input has autoFocus → you can type straight away
Create is disabled: name is still empty
→ setName(...) → ONLY NewProjectDialog re-renders (its own state)
→ the input shows the new text; Create enables once name.trim() isn't empty
Press Enter or click Create → handleSubmit(e)
e.preventDefault() → stop the browser's default (reloading the page)
const trimmed = name.trim(); if empty → return
await createProject({ name: trimmed }) → sent over the WebSocket
Table changed → Convex re-runs the subscribed queries:
getPartial(6) → ProjectsList updates; get() → search dialog updates
setName("") → clears the field for next time
router.push("/projects/<id>") → go to the new project's page
Cancel, Esc, click outside, or X
Esc / outside / X: Radix calls onOpenChange(false)
Typed text is KEPT: NewProjectDialog stays mounted, so name survives
